command: cd /workspace/inventory && cat pyproject.toml && echo "---CHANGELOG---" && cat CHANGELOG.md 2>/dev/null || echo "(no changelog)"
cd /workspace/inventory && for f in src/inventory/stock.py src/inventory/__init__.py src/inventory/pricing.py tests/test_stock.py tests/conftest.py; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace/inventory && for f in .gnomon/system.md .gnomon/policy.toml .gnomon/config.toml .gnomon/skills/writing-tests.md .gnomon/skills/secrets.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

cd /workspace/inventory && sed -i 's/^version = "0.4.0"$/version = "0.5.0"/' pyproject.toml && sed -i 's/^__version__ = "0.4.0"$/__version__ = "0.5.0"/' src/inventory/__init__.py && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "--- verify ---" && grep -n 'version' pyproject.toml && grep -n '__version__' src/inventory/__init__.py && cat CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '1,20p' src/inventory/stock.py

cd /workspace/inventory && cp src/inventory/stock.py /tmp/stock.bak
echo "== mutation 1: restock fails to return the level =="
sed -i 's/^        return self._levels\[sku\]$/        return None/' src/inventory/stock.py
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
cp /tmp/stock.bak src/inventory/stock.py
echo "== mutation 2: validation dropped =="
sed -i 's/^        if qty <= 0:$/        if False:/' src/inventory/stock.py
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
cp /tmp/stock.bak src/inventory/stock.py
echo "== restored =="
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2 && git status --short && git diff --stat
